items.html: Thus it is found that this Ibur [impregnation] is not to emanate ZON anew, for they had already been emanated; rather, they were without the correction of lines and without a Partzuf, and also they were lacking — this one from VAK alone and that one from a single point alone. Now, the Ibur was to bind them together in the secret of lines, and also in the secret of a Partzuf, and also to complete each one with ten complete Sefirot. And this is through the drops of AVI, and through the new name MA, which has been explained above.
